scope: 80 html5lib entity tokenizer expectations projected into DOM text/attribute observations, five explicit WHATWG named/numeric supplements and finite Canvas RGBA export; not tokenizer error-event or WPT conformance
normalization: Attribute order is not observed; selected cases have one attribute.
Character-token segmentation is projected to DOM textContent.
Compare exact Unicode strings and exact RGBA bytes, never trim whitespace or normalize Unicode.
PNG compression/chunk bytes are not compared; independent decoded pixels are exact.
gaps: Browser DOM does not expose tokenizer parse-error events: corpus errors metadata retained, not asserted.
Primitive entity lookup is a separate native contract and does not establish tokenizer behavior.
WPT requires an official checkout/runner and a supported Mioa product integration; no built-in Mioa WPT product adapter is provided.

optional_p1_fuzz_tools.reason: Optional campaigns are not prerequisites or claimed executions; dedicated structured primitive campaigns run through the separate quality fuzz entry.

wpt.reason: No WPT runner requested by default; official tooling delegation is explicit. Exit zero alone never proves test outcomes.
